$comment: Vercel WAF rate-limit rules for the cloud-service endpoints. Source of truth for docs/CLOUD_SERVICE.md#global-rate-limits-vercel-waf. Apply with scripts/firewall-rules.mjs (stages drafts only; the owner reviews and publishes). Limits are per client IP, per Vercel region, fixed window; window is in seconds (Pro allows 10-600).

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-notams
rules.description: GET /api/data/notams per IP (FAA NOTAM quota). Mirror: 1 req per airport per 30 min.

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-stocks
rules.description: GET /api/data/stocks and /api/data/stock-profiles per IP (Finnhub quota). Mirror: 1 req per symbol per 5 min.

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-oauth-config
rules.description: GET /api/oauth/config per IP. Mirror caches it 10 min (1 min after a failure).

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-oauth-token
rules.description: POST /api/oauth/google/token per IP (code exchange + hourly refresh per Google account).
